entries.subject: alb-idle-timeout

scriptRef.notMeasurableLocally: An Application Load Balancer is an AWS service and cannot run on localhost; no cloud account is used.

entries.notes: AWS documents idle_timeout.timeout_seconds with the default of 60 seconds (read 2026-11-11). The value can be changed in the console outside Git, so its absence from the files does not establish it; a result that rests on it is unresolved.
